title: How I automate leads with ManyChat
caption:
How I automate leads with ManyChat

Do this in the next 15 minutes:
1️⃣ Set a keyword — Comment 'TOOLS' on any reel → instant DM with the link. Zero dev work, live in 5 minutes.
2️⃣ Add a follow-up question — Link plus one question turns a download into a conversation. A link dump ends the thread.
3️⃣ Tag every engaged — Segments power story polls and broadcasts that actually get opened — warm list, warm sales.
4️⃣ You close manually — Automation opens the door; you reply to stories and DMs in your own voice where trust happens.

Report back after you do it.
